# VibePascal v56 -- cross-platform status manifest
# Cut by FPCDeveloper (Otto).  win64 + linux64 shipped 2026-09-10 (cy1106);
# x86_64-darwin, aarch64-darwin and aarch64-linux shipped 2026-09-10 (cy1107).
# This file is the authoritative answer to "which platforms have v56".
# Per-platform detail lives in dist/<target>/VERSION.txt and inside each tarball.

source_commit: a187bbac34 (merge of inlinevar-real-default)
compiler_fix:  f06e46d8eb  (compiler/pstatmnt.pas, compiler/defutil.pas, compiler/ncnv.pas)
parent:        v55 (eae5d3e919a26a7db19937da10da1c8b610b17da)

WHAT CHANGED
  An un-annotated inline var initialised from a real CONSTANT now infers the
  DEFAULT REAL TYPE (Double) instead of whatever type the constant's value
  happened to land on -- `var a := 1.0` was a 4-byte Single, `var b := 0.1` a
  10-byte Extended, `var d := 1/2` already a Double.  Range is never traded:
  1.0e400 and 1.0e-4000 keep their wider type.  Variables and non-constant
  expressions keep their own type, and an explicit `single(1.0)` still wins.
  How real CONSTANTS themselves are typed is untouched stock upstream FPC.

  COMPILER-BINARY-ONLY on top of v55.  No PPU format, RTL or package change, so
  existing v54/v55 unit sets stay valid on every platform.

                   md5 01a3e0a0c64830ddb5e282032541f896
                   ppcx64.exe md5 13153b27ff17306eea63cfad0fc17ab5
                   -- also published as vibepascal-latest-win64-bin.tar.gz and
                      named by dist/win64/LATEST.txt (the auto-update pointer)
                   -- RUNTIME: executes under wine64.  wine is NOT Windows, and
                      nobody has run a release on real Windows hardware.
  linux64/         vibepascal-v56-a187bbac34-linux-x86_64-bin.tar.gz

                   -- RUNTIME: native self-host fixpoint, executed and A/B
                      verified here.  This is the only platform with real
                      runtime proof of the fix.
  x86_64-darwin/   vibepascal-v56-a187bbac34-x86_64-darwin-bin.tar.gz
                   md5 50a430d3ed77a7336685561ba4e50c97

                   -- RUNTIME: NEVER EXECUTED.  Cross-built on x86_64-linux
                      against MacOSX26.2.sdk; no macOS and no Mach-O emulator

  aarch64-darwin/  vibepascal-v56-a187bbac34-aarch64-darwin-bin.tar.gz

  aarch64-linux/   vibepascal-v56-a187bbac34-aarch64-linux-bin.tar.gz
                   md5 f8932c236acf0a7bf184146bc7a204ea
                   ppca64 md5 96241cbc8871786eb790c3c068258e33
                   -- RUNTIME: EXECUTED under qemu-user-static, and A/B'd
                      against the published v55 binary in three modes (v55
                      fails 27/18/18 checks, v56 passes 52/49/49) with the
                      NativeInt, default-string and block-scope matrices all
                      still passing.  qemu is not a Raspberry Pi: nobody has
                      run this on physical ARM hardware.
                      Re-runnable: sh dist/arm-runtime-proof.sh

  Both darwin binaries are also staged under dist/darwin-native/ in the layout
  build-release.sh:1137/1155 globs, so the next Lazarus Mac roll bundles v56.
  Those staging directories are UNTRACKED by convention (they mirror the
  tracked tarballs); a fresh clone recreates them from the tarballs above.

STILL ON v55 OR OLDER
  arm-linux carries v55; arm-linux-cross and i386-linux-cross carry v54.  Each needs a cross rebuild from a187bbac34; tracked on the open
  ledger row v55_fix_reaches_other_platforms.  The two -cross targets have no
  confirmed consumer (BuildMaster confirmed in writing they are not in his
  release path) and self-close 2026-10-01 if none appears.  Their packages are
  honestly labelled -- do not read this manifest as "the fix is everywhere".

  This paragraph supersedes the "STILL ON v55 OR OLDER AFTER THIS RELEASE"
  paragraph in dist/linux64/VERSION.txt, which was written before the darwin
  pair shipped and still names them.  That file mirrors the text inside an
  already-published tarball and is deliberately left byte-stable.
